q: Should The Rogue Cut count as on screen? In it Xavier, Magneto and Bobby rescue Rogue from Cerebro and she takes over holding Logan's mind (he senses her). The theatrical cut gives her a wordless three-second cameo only.
why: The rules say only what's on screen but not which cut of a film is the title; the Rogue Cut is an official extended release with real exchanges absent from the theatrical cut. The owner should pick which cut the title means (theatrical only would keep Rogue's ties here stage-free).

q: Maria Hill is listed in Spider-Man: Far From Home, but on screen she is Soren in disguise the whole time and the real Hill never appears. Keep Far From Home in Hill's appearances?
why: The real Maria Hill never appears in Far From Home: the Hill on screen is Soren throughout, revealed in the film's own post-credits scene, and Fandom lists Hill there only as mentioned. The rules settle stages, not appearance lists; by analogy with the same-person rule the impostor is not Hill, so dropping Far From Home from Hill's appearances (and giving no Hill stages there) looks right.
